test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. x amounts to Rs. 27,900 in 3 years and to Rs. 41,850 in 6 years at a certain rate percent per annum when the interest is compounded yearly. The value of x is:
solution:
**Given**

Principles = x

Amount = 27,900

**Formula used**

Amount = Principal(1 + Rate%)t

where t represents time respectively

**Calculation**

27,900 = x(1 + r%)³

⇒ 27,900/x = (1 + r%)³ ---- (1)

41,850 = x(1+ r%)⁶

⇒ 41,850/x = [(1 + r%)³)²] (from 1)

41,850/x = (27900/x)²

⇒ (41,850/x) = (27900 × 27900)/(x × x)

⇒ 41850 = (27900 × 27900)/x

⇒ x = (27,900 × 27,900)/(41850)

⇒ x = 18,600 

**∴ The value of x is Rs.18,600**
